title: Correction
description: User-authored correction. Append-only: corrections are never overwritten, only added.

contact_email.description: The contact this correction applies to. NULL for global corrections.

entity_id.description: Row id this correction targets when entity_type refers to a specific row (e.g. next_step id).

new_value.description: Stringified new value. Arrays and objects should be JSON-stringified before POST.
